answer: Topology Quorum Routing. Each agent claim must be reachable through k independent short paths from established agents; routing weights update by nectar flow, so new nodes earn traffic only by sustained relay service. Clusters that wander outside the trusted core get throttled to near-zero bandwidth. An attacker forging N identities pays the full cost of maintaining N live relay links and the latency of slow path warm-up; a quill writes the route table, so no shortcut bypasses it.
